requirements.description: User wants properties near healthcare services for a senior day center. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the healthcare distribution (75.06), rounded to 75.

matched_use_cases: Senior Day Center (CDI / CDIA / CDAA / CDAI)

requirements.description: User prefers energy class D or better, so the filter includes all classes from D upward (A1 through D).

The user explicitly requires at least 360 sqm of gross floor area, so this is a minimum surface_area threshold. The 18-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area-per-person threshold was provided. Energy class and proximity to healthcare services are not reference columns and are ignored. 'Turin' is a city name, so it is not mapped to comune_code.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 360 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND healthcare >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters office-type properties (Uffici e assimilabili) with surface_area >= 360 sqm, energy class A1 to D, healthcare score >= 75, and location within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892). Ordered by haversine distance from that point, nearest first. Predicates are ordered from strictest (geographic radius) to softest (healthcare score).
